body:
Context: the repository cut over to segmented (forest) manifest storage on 2026-08-10 (PR #482, T-MANIFEST-FOREST-MIGRATE). The root `.adlc/manifest.jsonl` is frozen at 270 lines; the marker `.adlc/manifest.d/.store.json` ({"format":"adlc-manifest-segments","version":1,"auth":"keyed"}) directs all new evidence into per-branch segments. A pre-1.10.0 toolkit predates the forest verbs: it never reads the marker and will append evidence directly to the frozen root. CI's rails-guard forest gate (spec §9, shipped in #470) rejects such a diff at PR time — but only after the developer has already written bad evidence locally, with a confusing late failure. The cutover ceremony's own followUps list requires pinning a toolkit floor.

Threat analysis (do not widen scope beyond it): for `pull_request` CI runs, workflows and validators execute from the MERGE ref, so a stale branch is already validated by base's forest-aware gate code — no change needed there for the common path. The remaining gaps are: (1) a developer or agent with a stale GLOBAL `adlc` CLI (< 1.10.0) writing root appends locally and only discovering it at PR time; (2) CI runs that execute branch code without merging base (workflow_dispatch / push-triggered runs on a branch); (3) a branch that deliberately or accidentally downgrades the in-tree gate packages.

Build:
1. Single source of truth for the floor: add `scripts/toolkit-floor.json` containing {"minToolkit": "1.10.0", "reason": "forest cutover PR #482 — pre-forest toolkits append to the frozen manifest root"}. No other file may hardcode the floor value.
2. Preflight enforcement: `npm run preflight` fails (exit non-zero, actionable message naming the floor file and `npm i -g @adlc/cli@latest`) when BOTH (a) `.adlc/manifest.d/.store.json` exists and (b) a globally resolvable `adlc --version` reports a semver lower than minToolkit. A missing global `adlc` is NOT a failure (CI has none; in-tree code is what runs there). Version comparison must be semver-aware (1.10.0 > 1.9.0 — no string compare).
3. CI belt-and-suspenders: in the `rails-guard` job of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, add a step that fails when `.adlc/manifest.d/.store.json` exists in the checked-out tree but `packages/gate-manifest/package.json` version < minToolkit (guards gaps 2 and 3). Note: editing this workflow requires regenerating `scripts/test/rails-guard-workflow-hashes.json`, and both files are trust-root tier — the PR needs a distinct-provider cross-model attestation to pass the gate.
4. Docs: extend the migrate section of `docs/tools/gate-manifest.md` with one short paragraph: after a cutover, set/verify the toolkit floor so pre-forest toolkits fail fast instead of writing the frozen root.

Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: `scripts/toolkit-floor.json` exists with minToolkit 1.10.0 and is the only place the floor value appears (verify: `git grep -l '1\.10\.0' scripts/ .github/` shows the floor only in toolkit-floor.json and files that read it at runtime; a test asserts the CI step and preflight both read the file rather than a literal).
- AC2: with the marker present and a stubbed `adlc` on PATH reporting 1.9.0, `npm run preflight` exits non-zero and its message names the floor and the upgrade command (verify: automated test using a temp dir with a fake `adlc` shim and a fixture marker).
- AC3: with no global `adlc` on PATH, preflight does not fail on the floor check (verify: automated test with PATH scrubbed of the shim).
- AC4: semver comparison is real: a stubbed `adlc` reporting 1.10.1 and one reporting 2.0.0 both pass (verify: same test harness, both cases asserted).
- AC5: the CI rails-guard job fails when the marker exists and the in-tree `packages/gate-manifest` version is set below the floor (verify: unit test invoking the check script directly against a fixture tree; plus the step is present in ci.yml and `scripts/test/rails-guard-workflow-hashes.json` is regenerated so the workflow-hash test passes).
- AC6: docs paragraph added to docs/tools/gate-manifest.md migrate section (verify: content review; spec-lint not required for docs).

Out of scope: changing `.adlc/manifest.d/.store.json` (the marker is frozen by the gate and its grammar is railed spec territory); any attempt to make pre-1.10.0 binaries themselves refuse (unfixable retroactively — the floor check plus the CI forest gate is the containment); npm engines/peerDeps mechanisms.
title: Pin the minimum ADLC toolkit version now that the manifest root is frozen (forest cutover follow-up)
